evidence.proved: quoted, OpenAtom Foundation announcement of the AtomGit launch: Notebook Space 1000
quoted, Beihang University School of Software announcement: Notebook Space 1,000
quoted hands-on account 2026-07-13: single 910B card, maximum 2 hours per session, 50 GB temporary storage, environment deleted on close, quota visible as remaining core-hours
quoted forum post 2026-09-01: 1,000 core-hours a month, and the arithmetic that 1000 / 32 vCPU is about 31 instance-hours while a 4-core shape gives about 250

notes: The unit is the finding: 1,000 core-hours a month is not 1,000 GPU-hours. GitCode and AtomGit merged in 2026 and both names appear for this product. The figures rest on the foundation announcement plus two hands-on accounts.
